title: 20230424-unloading-Ship
description:
The roll-on/roll-off ship New Amsterdam was loaded on April 19, 2023 by soldiers from the port handling company in Emden. Within 6 hours, under the leadership of Lieutenant Captain Florian, the ship was loaded and all vehicles were safely moored. The New Amsterdam will now arrive in Sardinia within a week, where the VJTF Land Brigade vehicles are taking part in Exercise Noble Jump 2023. Video by MSgt (OR-7) Sven Fischer, DEU-A

I'm here today in charge of port handling operations for Noble Jump and we have here today from a 251 vehicles from the German, Dutch and Luxembourg army plus four sea containers.
